verdict.rationale: WorkOS is an enterprise auth/identity platform (SSO, Directory Sync, RBAC, Audit Logs, Vault); its MCP server lets agents call the WorkOS API on-demand to manage workspace settings, but this is interactive/agent-initiated administration, not a mechanism for AI-native users to schedule or configure autonomous background automations. This capability (workflow/automation orchestration) is outside WorkOS's product category, so the axis does not apply.
